subtitle: Lesson 11 · The Weekly Sales & Fulfillment Report

code:
-- Click the card. Look at the Fields pane's
-- Values well. NOT the card's title text.

-- Title says "Total Sales".
-- Values well says [Total Sales (All Regions)].
caption: A visual's title has no guaranteed relationship to its actual measure.

code:
-- Add a TEST card, explicitly bound to [Total Sales].
-- Filter the page to Pacific.

-- Suspect card: unchanged.
-- Test card: matches the Drill-Down page's Pacific total.
caption: One variable changed, output changed exactly as predicted.

code:
Total Sales (All Regions) =
  CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], ALL ( TerritoryDim ) )

-- ALL(TerritoryDim) strips the Region slicer's filter.
-- With NO region picked: both measures match (coincidence).
-- Card bound to the WRONG one of two adjacent measures.
caption: A legitimate measure, bound to the wrong visual — a binding mistake, not a formula mistake.

subtitle: Now that the cause is confirmed, make the fix.
